module.description: The TabPanels renderer and its options.
module.name: tab-panels

ui.guidance: This is the one navigation component that genuinely needs script, and it claims role="tablist" only because it implements the whole contract: a single tab stop for the set (roving tabindex), Left/Right to move between tabs, Home/End to jump to the ends, and aria-selected plus aria-controls wiring the tab to its panel. NavTabs is the alternative for navigation between URLs - tabs that are really links should stay links. The server renders the fallback rather than the enhanced state: every panel open, in order, with the tab bar hidden. Collapsing to one panel before the controller exists would lose every panel but the first, and offering tabs only a controller can operate would be a row of dead buttons; uiTabs reveals the bar and collapses to the selected panel on init.
ui.keyboard: A roving tabindex gives the set one tab stop; Left/Right move and activate the adjacent tab, and Home/End jump to the first or last.
ui.name: tab-panels

module.title: TabPanels
